intro.what: A giant mantis, Kamacuras, glides low over the jungle treetops past the expedition's weather tower, 0:25:25.

loop.what: Kamacuras creeps over the jungle treetops, peering about with its scythe claws raised, in one calm shot, 0:24:45.

kill.what: A run of shots: Godzilla's ray bursts into flames on a Kamacuras, which reels on the plain engulfed in fire, 0:34:17.

escape.what: Kamacuras spreads its wings and flies off over the mountainside, escaping Godzilla's ray, 0:58:54.

wave.what: Three Kamacuras crowd together in close-up before the mountain, their glowing eyes turning, 0:31:53.

boss.what: The last Kamacuras rears up in a low-angle close-up and slashes its scythe claws at the camera, 0:56:38.

won.what: A run of shots: Kamacuras hangs impaled on a power pylon in close-up, its claws twitching, then its head sags as it dies, 1:15:26.

lost.what: Kamacuras looms over a cornered Minilla with its huge scythe claws raised to strike, 0:58:26.

swoop.what: Kamacuras swoops down onto the top of the Grande Arche in Paris with its wings buzzing out, then lunges at the camera, 0:23:04.

lit.what: A Kamacuras close-up: the mantis swings its head round from profile to stare at the camera with its glowing orange eyes, 0:56:23.

music.what: Masaru Sato's main title march from Son of Godzilla, brass and percussion over the opening credits, no effects or dialogue, 0:02:54.

kill.what: A heavy crash as Godzilla wrestles a Kamacuras over in a cloud of dust, 0:34:07.

escape.what: A Kamacuras screeches, a shrill rasping cry, as it rears up with wings spread over the jungle, 1:10:57.

wave.what: Kamacuras screech together as the three mantises are seen gathered below the mountain, 0:25:36.

boss.what: The last Kamacuras gives a long shrill screech in close-up as it squares up to Minilla, 0:56:24.

won.what: A burning Kamacuras gives a falling death screech over the roar of the flames, 0:34:19.

lost.what: Godzilla cries out in pain, clutching his eye after a stinger strikes, 1:18:51.

swoop.what: A sharp Kamacuras screech as the mantis strides in toward Minilla, 0:56:31.
